findings.text: blocking: the new dependency parser requires quoted name and content attributes, so valid <meta name=plan-depends-on content=upstream> yields no wait while the existing BeautifulSoup read_state in reckon/_plan_html.py:1455 yields upstream; this changes release decisions, and the local regex parser duplicates rather than extends that metadata owner.

blocking: the body-free fast path always uses _meta_head_fields, which truncates at 16384 characters and requires name= and content= without intervening whitespace; a plan with no data-reckon body and section declarations below that cut, or authored as name = "plan-section-declarations", now returns an empty section_declarations map at :6707 whereas the former _read_readiness_state parsed the full document.

non-blocking: BASE_DECISIONS expects launched=[] and two refused verdicts in both lane cases, including once_two_slots, so the new base comparison never proves a successful launch survives sweep reuse; fold a valid launchable fixture and a nonempty independent launch expectation into the repair node for these findings.

non-blocking: the added source comment embeds a transient base revision and added prose in wait_refs.py:234 describes what the code used to do; replace these with mechanism descriptions in the repair node to satisfy the repository's naming and comment rules.
